notes.title: Starlight Reboot
notes.content:
We have been busy! We are just returning from a trip to game conferences in Europe, testing online, and showcasing our immersive sci-fi adventure at festivals in the USA. Gamers have provided vital feedback about the project and this translated to dev sessions that will bring infinite procedural worlds and much more. This project will also see a brand update, from "Exo" to "Starlight"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39357214/a6065d763108eefe846edfe571199050e913aa80.png

Specific things that will be changing with the reboot include:


 Infinite procedural worlds
 New hero model
 New amazing soundtrack from Mystik Sound
 New skies and exotic alien planets, species and cultures
 Crafting and resource management
 An astrolabe puzzle mechanic to decode stellar alignment
 Land surveys and archeology
 Map
 Compass
 Fast-travel
 Video clips through each level telling a story of exploration and discovery
 AR heads-up display and a complete UI rewrite


These features are all completed except crafting and survival. We will be going into a testing round early this summer. Once issues testing surface have been resolved, we will release, slated for Q4 2024.

This was our first game, and we much appreciate early adopters and those who continue to show interest.  We have learned so much and the original release, although seeing early attention and traction suffered from issues that prevented it from finding the audience it deserves.

The Starlight reboot will be released with 4+ levels and priced based on the amount of content that we create. There will be more levels and all customers receive updates without additional costs.

Follow us on Discord or Instagram for regular updates.

Thank You!

notes.title: Exo: 4-Level Update
notes.content:
Lost in Time and Space

Explore Exotic Exoplanets on a Search for Alien Life

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39357214/78d398c323b63a3fbe4581800fa39f2f9b8a5989.jpg

Immersive Science Fiction Adventure

Discover new life, sentient species, and exotic exoplanets in this third-person exploration game from Superframe. Play as a research android launched from Earth to explore the Galaxy. Hundreds of light years from home, and traveling far into the future, voyage at close to the speed of light to neighboring exoplanets thought to harbor life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39357214/df844fc2e12b2bcf79bce45c41be1a84c1382e52.jpg

4-Level Upgrade

Superframe is pleased to announce a 4-Level content upgrade for our immersive sci-fi adventure Exo. This early-release title is aiming for a full release late in 2023.  The current price reflects the amount of content currently available and when the product launches all existing customers will receive the full game and an art ebook at the discounted early-release price.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39357214/4017bc472bc14a93f16369fc4abe8f1115a14d18.jpg

Immersive Adventure

With a focus on exploration, this game finds you exploring alien landscapes and communicating your findings back to Mission Control back on Earth. As you travel among the stars, you will encounter signs of a lost alien race. Follow in their footsteps as you voyage to exoplanets that orbit within the habitable zone of their host stars.

Finding alien species, discovering sentient lifeforms, and collecting alien relics are some of the tasks you will need to accomplish to complete your missions. Equipped with a star drive, a powerful jetpack, and a research drone to help you map the worlds you visit, you have everything you need to explore the wonders of the Universe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39357214/35d3791fcc73fdc8e684ff8993b9c481bbdae675.jpg

Solar-Powered with an Unlimited Lifespan.

As a solar-powered android, you have an unlimited lifespan and the ability to explore indefinitely. Traveling in stasis for the many years it takes to travel the Cosmos, conditions on Earth are constantly evolving. With voyages lasting decades, each time Exo reports back home, life for humanity has changed, as does the space agency and your role as Earth’s envoy to the stars.

Key Features:


 	Travel the Galaxy as a solar-powered research android with an unlimited lifespan
 	Explore habitable exoplanets that have been discovered here on earth
 	Discover and record alien species, sentient life, and archeological relics
 	Solve puzzles left behind by an alien race communicating in Earth’s most ancient written language
 	Map alien terrains with a helper drone that travels with you
 	Communicate your findings to Mission Control on Earth with quantum communication technology
 	Follow events on Earth as you travel deeper into the Cosmos and farther forward in time
 	Uncover the mystery of a lost race and learn about our origins in the Universe


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39357214/18600c997c3ef0c1d12c84189715844bd5103527.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39357214/f4b66a09a171391f75afc652b955f91c51b67efa.png

notes.title: Important Updates, Full Sceen Mode, Player control Fix, Drone Updates
notes.content:
This patch fixes a few issues and adds some improvements.


 Player can now go travel backwards to better avoid threats
 Drone going in the mountain error is fixed
 Drone getting in the way of the player is now fixed
 Full-screen mode enabled to remove black bars on the sides of the screen
 Performance enhancements for low-graphics mode

notes.title: Dangerous Threats and Resource Collection
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39357214/f95d47142fe22e0cfcbfaee99bcf6db9730f7425.png
Alien Threats and Resource Collection
New Features:

 Alien Threats that Must Be Avoided
 Resource Collection
 Faster Low-Gravity Walking Speed
 Additional Audio to Help Solve the Holographic Puzzle

Our customers are asking for features and we are busy completing the code base before building out the next release with four new levels. We have all of the content for the next update and are currently assembling the pieces.

With this update,  the player will now be able to collect resources and avoid dangerous species. Extended encounters with alien creatures will beam the player back to the level origin, permanently losing the resources they have collected.

We are adding two team members and polishing the pitch deck. Next, we will be contacting publishers and seeing if there is a potential good fit.

Either way, the four level-demo is going to happen and will be available to all current and future customers.

notes.title: Summer 2021 Update
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39357214/f95d47142fe22e0cfcbfaee99bcf6db9730f7425.png

Our users have been providing great feedback and we have been hard at work incorporating it. We are also happy to announce that we will be working with the very talented minds at Mystik Sound to create an amazing soundtrack for the game.

There is now a narrative layer with Exo now communicating with Mission Control through the portal via radio contact. 

We have created a new player model for the research android. The helper drone has seen a rewrite, with it mapping the world on its own initiative. The player can still control it but left to its own initiative, it will map all of the items necessary to complete the level.

Scientific surveys have also been added that players can complete, with the player learning more about the alien worlds it visits.

There have been several UI enhancements, a DNA gathering challenge, and multiple bug fixes.

[olist]
 Exo Android and Mission Control narration
 New Player skin for the International Space Agency's research android Exo
 Drone rewrite, with the drone mapping all necessary items to complete the level
 New interdimensional portal model
 Scientific surveys the player can complete to learn more about the alien worlds.
 The ability to show and hide markers
 DNA puzzle (WIP)
 UI enhancements
 Player collision 
[/olist]

notes.title: New UI and Better Controls
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/696630/ss_e7d3d88b5480a28c23379abcca9c367113a2d021.600x338.jpg?t=1624849690

We have been busy incorporating feedback and have a new music partnership in the works with an amazingly talented DJ/Electronic artist. 

New updates include

 New UI Screens
 PS4 and XBOX controller setups
 The ability to invert the y-axis on controllers
 The ability to save and load levels
 The ability to change graphics settings while in-game


The puzzle mechanic should be clearer and plans include adding a narrative layer to better orient players.

If you play the demo, please consider filling out our survey! Our hope is to have the community help us craft this game into something special. We are keeping things a little bit mysterious, but there are challenges and a puzzle that needs to be solved to open the Stargate.

You will still need a mouse and keyboard to get things set up and the game is more enjoyable if you have a controller around.
